target.title: docs(xai): make grok-build-0.1 recommended for coding flows
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`grok-build-0.1` exists in the xAI model catalog and is already noted for build/coding work, but guidance for the documented coding surfaces covered here (`coding-agent` skill and ACPX) was weak or missing.

Closes #99191

## Why This Change Was Made

This PR adds explicit recommendations, config examples, and a focused test assertion so operators know to prefer `xai/grok-build-0.1` for coding tasks via agent defaults or ACP session model selection where the selected harness supports that model ref.

All changes are documentation and a single catalog test assertion. Wording notes that external ACP harnesses own their auth, installed CLI, and accepted model ids.

## User Impact

Improves discoverability of the recommended Grok model for coding without affecting existing harness behavior or defaults.

## Evidence

Implemented:

- Documentation/examples across xAI provider docs, ACP agent docs, ACPX README, and the `coding-agent` skill.
- Focused xAI catalog assertion for `grok-build-0.1`.

Test-proven:

- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` -> clean.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/xai/index.test.ts` -> 16/16 passed.
- `pnpm docs:list` -> completed.

Not claimed:

- `runtime_proven`.
- `end_to_end_proven`.

Additional local note:

- A Windows-host attempt to run `pnpm test:extension xai` reached 201/205 passing tests, but four unrelated `extensions/xai/web-search.test.ts` expectations failed on `/tmp` vs `C:\tmp` path normalization. Those tests do not cover the changed docs/catalog assertion.

## What Was Not Tested

- Live execution of ACP sessions or coding-agent background work using `grok-build-0.1`.
- Interaction with external harness auth flows.
- ACPX runtime, model forwarding, or harness adapter behavior changes.

## Scope Statement

This PR is intentionally small and limited to docs/examples plus one test assertion. It is separate from:

- PR #99088 for xAI realtime voice.
- The separate xAI streaming TTS branch.

## Dependency Statement

No dependency graph change. No new or modified runtime dependencies.
